inputs.text: [excited] sor… OL… oh… fus. [curious] In ancient Greek, "sauro" is lizard. And "lophus" is crest. [pauses] The crested lizard.
[curious] A crest, like a pointy hat?
[happily] Almost. A long spike of solid bone, straight, [curious] pointing up and back. [warmly] He lived seventy million years ago.
[serious] Here's the amazing part: in Canada, and [confident] in Mongolia too, on the other side of the world, at the same time. [amazed] A land bridge connected the two continents back then.
